note: One corpus, read by BOTH the Go hub tests and the dashboard node tests.
The hub decides what may be totalled; the dashboard decides what may be
drawn and what a cell says. Those two policies must agree, and the way to
make a disagreement VISIBLE is a single shared list of cases rather than
two matrices maintained in parallel. Two copies do not detect divergence;
kind is what the reading may be counted as: measured, estimated, or
unknown. unknown means the hub will not put it in a total and the
dashboard will not draw it as a value — an unrecognised or unlabelled
backend, one whose scope cannot be vouched for, or an ambiguous window.
This file is TEST-ONLY. Nothing at runtime reads it, and it defines no

cases.name: psys measures the platform
an active BMC reading measures the platform
a BMC reporting an active zero is a real reading
cases.why: the agent already refused a deactivated one; zero here is the BMC's answer

cases.name: the package sum measures the CPU
the dram sub-zones measure dram
a GPU total carries no scalar label by construction
a GPU parked at zero is a real reading
an unlabelled CPU reading is the legacy RAPL package sum
cases.why: agents predating source labelling emitted CPU and GPU only

cases.name: an all-zero legacy CPU window is ambiguous
cases.why: samples cannot separate a frozen counter from zero energy, so it is not totalled

cases.name: an unlabelled system reading matches no agent that shipped
cases.why: System, DRAM and Sources were introduced in one commit

cases.name: an unlabelled system zero is unknown for the same reason
an unlabelled dram reading matches no agent that shipped
an all-zero RAPL package window is ambiguous
an all-zero RAPL dram window is ambiguous
an all-zero psys window is ambiguous
a positive peak with a rounded-zero mean is a measurement
cases.why: the counter moved; this is the case a blanket > 0 filter would destroy

cases.name: the package sum is not whole-machine power
dram is not whole-machine power
board power is not package power
the platform zone is not package power
the package sum is not dram power
a battery may be carrying only part of the load
a shunt names its chip, never its rail
ACPI's power meter does not declare its scope either
cases.why: the kernel gives power*_is_battery and measures/ symlinks for exactly this reason

cases.name: component CPU hwmon keeps its classification
cases.why: the exclusion is about a whole-machine CLAIM, not about hwmon

cases.name: component dram hwmon keeps its classification
a labelled modelled reading stays modelled
cases.why: nothing generates these any more; older agents and stored rows still carry them

cases.name: an all-zero modelled reading is still modelled, not withheld
cases.why: the frozen-counter rule is about counters; a model has none

cases.name: a backend this build does not recognise is not promoted to measured
an unrecognised backend in the cpu domain is unknown too
